B.text: If the plotted series is the cooling water temperature series and the value inscriptions attached to the 2005 and 2014 markers encode their respective annual temperatures, then the full-period change is the 2014 value minus the 2005 value; if a decrease of that magnitude qualifies as substantial under the routing criterion, select substantial-change follow-up.
B.conditions: Applies to the 2005-2014 endpoints. The chart provides no numeric or qualitative definition of 'substantial,' so the final routing condition is not verified by the supplied evidence.
